target.title: fix(elevenlabs): validate baseUrl with user-friendly error for malformed endpoints (fixes #106943)
target.body:
<details>
<summary>Additional instructions</summary>

**MUST:** Keep **Allow edits from maintainers** enabled for this PR so maintainers
can help update the branch when needed.

</details>

## What Problem This Solves

`normalizeElevenLabsBaseUrl` in `extensions/elevenlabs/shared.ts` only trimmed whitespace and stripped trailing slashes — it performed no URL validation. A user setting `baseUrl: "not a url"` would get a raw `TypeError: Invalid URL` from `new URL()` deeper in the call chain with no indication the misconfiguration was in the ElevenLabs baseUrl setting.

This is the same pattern that was fixed for Deepgram in #105334, which added proper URL validation with user-friendly error messages and scheme mapping.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added URL validation to `normalizeElevenLabsBaseUrl` following the Deepgram pattern from #105334:
- Parse the trimmed value as a URL, throw `Invalid ElevenLabs baseUrl: value is not a valid URL` on failure
- Reject non-http/https schemes with a descriptive error
- Strip pathname trailing slashes, search, and hash for consistency

The realtime provider's `normalizeElevenLabsRealtimeBaseUrl` was simplified to reuse the validated base URL string (avoiding double URL parse) before rewriting the protocol for WebSocket transport.

Since `normalizeElevenLabsBaseUrl` is shared across all ElevenLabs providers (speech, TTS, media understanding, realtime transcription), the fix covers every ElevenLabs baseUrl configuration path.

## User Impact

Invalid ElevenLabs baseUrl values now produce a clear, actionable error message naming the affected setting instead of a raw `TypeError: Invalid URL`. Valid URLs, empty values (default), and http/https schemes are unchanged.

## Evidence

Live function probe against the real production function on current head:

```
$ node --import tsx -e "..."
=== normalizeElevenLabsBaseUrl — After Fix ===

1. Default (undefined): https://api.elevenlabs.io
2. Empty:              (default)
3. Valid HTTPS:        https://api.elevenlabs.io
4. Valid HTTP:         http://localhost:8080
5. Trailing slash:     https://custom.example.com

--- Malformed rejection ---
6. Invalid URL:        Invalid ElevenLabs baseUrl: value is not a valid URL
7. Bad scheme (ftp):   Invalid ElevenLabs baseUrl: unsupported scheme "ftp" (expected http or https)
8. Bad scheme (ws):    Invalid ElevenLabs baseUrl: unsupported scheme "ws" (expected http or https)

All cases verified.
```

- `extensions/elevenlabs/shared.ts` — added URL parse + scheme validation + error messages
- `extensions/elevenlabs/realtime-transcription-provider.ts` — simplified to reuse validated base URL
- `extensions/elevenlabs/shared.test.ts` — 10 test cases covering default, valid, trailing-slash, and malformed rejection
